description: Find transit stops and stations by stop number, stop code, or name from the static GTFS feeds. Searches the TTC, Hamilton HSR and GO Transit by default and merges the results; pass agency to search one agency only. Every result carries an agency field (TTC, HSR or GO). GO Transit results include the UP Express stations Union Station, Bloor, Weston and Pearson Airport.

agency.description: Optional agency filter: ttc, hsr or go. Omit to search all three agencies.

query.description: A stop number or part of a stop or station name, for example Union Station or Hamilton GO Centre

name: search_stops
